problem: Close a household's books for one month and file that month's tax prepayment.

claims.text: Debits equal credits for the month.
Every statement line has a ledger entry and every ledger entry has a statement line.

verifier.sensor: the bank's own statement export for the month
verifier.positive_control: a transaction known to be on the statement is found in the ledger
verifier.falsification_criterion: any statement line without a ledger entry, or any ledger entry without a statement line

claims.text: Each transaction is in the right tax category.

verifier.rubric: the category rules of the jurisdiction
verifier.pass_rule: the accountant signs the category sheet with no open query

claims.text: The cash balance stays above the stated floor next month.

verifier.scored_by: next month's closing balance compared with the forecast band

claims.text: The chosen tax treatment is the best one available.

actions.text: Add the month's entries to the ledger
actions.undo: revert the commit that added them

actions.text: File and pay the month's tax prepayment
actions.reach: the tax authority's record and the bank account

learning.on_correction: a misfiled transaction becomes a rule in the classifier, with that transaction as its test case

unverified: treatment: whether the chosen tax treatment is the best one available
whether the bank's statement export is itself complete
